$description: Light-mode semantic colours → :root. Values are shadcn/ui's own, unmodified, so a deployment can be verified against the source before anything is adjusted.

success.$description: bidezine Adjustment (not a shadcn/ui token — shadcn's own upstream source has no success/warning/info concept). Authored fresh for the design system's status-badge vocabulary; matches destructive's lightness/chroma weight, own hue. WCAG contrast vs white text: 4.94:1.

warning.$description: bidezine Adjustment. WCAG contrast vs white text: 4.91:1.

info.$description: bidezine Adjustment. WCAG contrast vs white text: 5.17:1.

destructive-soft.$description: bidezine Adjustment — a light, opaque tint of destructive's own hue for Badge's `tone="soft"` treatment (low-emphasis status pill: tinted background + saturated text, vs. the solid variant's white-on-filled-color). Deliberately opaque (not `bg-destructive/N` alpha) so contrast never depends on whatever surface the badge sits on. Same hue angle as `destructive`, own L/C tuned for a subtle pastel tint. Paired with destructive-soft-foreground: 7.05:1 contrast.

destructive-soft-foreground.$description: bidezine Adjustment — darker/more saturated shade of destructive's own hue, sized specifically for legibility on destructive-soft (a same-hue token pair, not reused from the solid destructive/destructive-foreground pair, which was tuned for white-on-filled-color instead). See destructive-soft.

success-soft.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft; same treatment, success's own hue. Paired with success-soft-foreground: 7.04:1 contrast.

success-soft-foreground.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft-foreground; success's own hue.

warning-soft.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft; same treatment, warning's own hue. Paired with warning-soft-foreground: 7.06:1 contrast.

warning-soft-foreground.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft-foreground; warning's own hue.

info-soft.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft; same treatment, info's own hue. Paired with info-soft-foreground: 7.11:1 contrast.

info-soft-foreground.$description: bidezine Adjustment — see destructive-soft-foreground; info's own hue.

chart-1.$description: shadcn aliases this to Tailwind's own blue-300; passthrough keeps the same alias instead of resolving it to a literal.

sidebar-rail-active.$description: What a rail row looks like when it is the current one.

sidebar-rail-active-hover.$description: Approved — extends the already-approved hover→pressed→active ramp one more step, inspired by navigation-menu.tsx's own data-[active=true]:hover:bg-accent precedent.

sidebar-rail-border-strong.$description: Approved: oklch(0.708 0 0) for both app modes (reuses the already-approved onDarkSubtle value / the base theme's own --ring token) — visibly stronger against the rail surface than

sidebar-rail-divider.$description: Reuses darkBorderStrong's original, already-reviewed value (oklch(0.256)/oklch(0.254)), now under its own name so raising the ring's brightness (M-13) doesn't also brighten this di

sidebar-rail-foreground.$description: Text and icons at full strength on the dark rail — the baseline the other three on-dark values step down from.

sidebar-rail-foreground-disabled.$description: Disabled text and icons on the rail, around 20%.

sidebar-rail-foreground-hover.$description: Text and icons on a rail row being hovered.

sidebar-rail-foreground-subtle.$description: Subordinate text on the rail, around 50% strength.

sidebar-rail-hover.$description: What a rail row looks like on hover.

sidebar-rail-pressed.$description: What a rail row looks like while it is being pressed — the step between hover and active, and only visible for an instant.

sidebar-rail-surface.$description: Approved: oklch(0.18 0 0) for dark app mode only (light app mode's oklch(0.205 0 0) is unchanged — no collision there against a white --background).
